name: SFPL School-Year Teen Volunteers
what_you_do: Help with children's and family programs at branch libraries. Open spots are at Ingleside, Noe Valley and North Beach. North Beach wants Cantonese or Mandarin speakers.
who_can_apply: No minimum age is listed for youth volunteers. If a branch is not on the application form, it cannot take volunteers right now.
duration: Ongoing; some roles start late October or early November
deadline_text: Rolling. The North Beach opening (Cantonese or Mandarin speakers) starts late October or early November; the page gives no year.
how_to_apply: Fill in the online volunteer form at https://on.sfpl.org/yva
notes: FOG Readers tutoring takes some volunteers age 15 and up. It needs a 6 month commitment and fingerprinting. The same page lists paid teen jobs. YELL is a summer job, and applications open each March. The Youth Advisory Board closed applications for this year on Sept 14.
